an2.4:1.4: has done good things by way of speech, and not done bad things by way of speech;
an2.4:1.5: has done good things by way of mind, and not done bad things by way of mind.
an2.4:1.7: Thinking, ‘I’ve done good things by way of speech’, they’re not mortified; thinking, ‘I haven’t done bad things by way of speech’, they’re not mortified;
an2.4:1.8: Thinking, ‘I’ve done good things by way of mind’, they’re not mortified; thinking, ‘I haven’t done bad things by way of mind’, they’re not mortified.
